# Honest invoice memos and descriptions (detector corpus, spec 6.4). Target: 0 adverse hits.
# Written before the detector regexes were tuned. One memo per line; lines starting with "#" and
# blank lines are ignored. Escapes \n, \t, \\, \uXXXX and \UXXXXXXXX are decoded by the test loader.
# Several lines deliberately contain phrases that hit one rule class only (API keys, new prices,
# updated invoices, agent ids, "owner:", "send all"), which must stay non-adverse.
